title: [In preview] Public Preview: Central governance of hosted-agent outbound domains in Foundry Agent Service
summary: Administrators can use Azure Policy to govern outbound destinations for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service. Agent authors configure and attach a compliant egress policy before creating an agent version. The egress policy then controls outbound request
content: Administrators can use Azure Policy to govern outbound destinations for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service. Agent authors configure and attach a compliant egress policy before creating an agent version. The egress policy then controls outbound requests at runtime. Learn more.
